speed.description: Communication speed (baud rate) for serial devices

model.description: Phone/modem model name (leave blank for autodetect; e.g., 'AT', 'Nokia5110')

logfile.description: Absolute path to the SMS daemon log file

sendsmsretryinterval.description: Seconds to wait between retries when sending a failed SMS

sendsmsretries.description: Maximum number of times to retry sending a failed SMS

sentfolder.description: Directory to archive successfully sent SMS

inboxfolder.description: Directory to store incoming SMS (not used if database is enabled)

errorfolder.description: Directory to store SMS that failed to send

pcsuite.description: Enable Nokia PC-Suite compatibility mode (only for legacy Nokia devices)

database_driver.description: Database backend ('mysql', 'postgresql', 'sqlite3'); leave empty to use local spool folders only

database_host.description: Database server hostname (ignored unless database_driver is set)

database_name.description: Name of the database used by Gammu SMS daemon

devices.description: List of additional devices for redundancy/failover
